name: deeplaw-knowledge-os
description: Explicit-use read-only DeepLaw Knowledge OS and bounded Context Capsule runtime.

interface.shortDescription: Compile governed local knowledge into bounded Agent context
interface.longDescription: DeepLaw Knowledge OS reads an explicitly selected local Markdown-native vault, preserves source-derived and Agent-derived authority partitions, and compiles task-specific, hash-verifiable Knowledge Capsules. This default plugin remains read-only and isolated from both the DeepLaw Legal Pack and the separately enabled Knowledge Sink.
defaultPrompt: Compile a verified Knowledge Capsule for this task
